_comment: Source of truth for Eva's lazy tool loading. 'core' is always attached; each group in 'groups' is gated behind search_tools+call_tool (no attach step, same-turn — see docs/2026-08-22-tool-discovery-spec.md). register-toolsets.sh injects 'groups' into use_toolset/search_tools/call_tool and applies 'core' to the eva agent. use_toolset and eva-web's keyword pre-load (toolset_router.py) are RETIRED as of 2026-08-22 (still registered/present in the codebase, just no longer attached/called) — a real live failure showed the keyword pre-load putting the wrong tool in her hands before she could search properly. 'index'/'keywords' below are now dead weight, kept only until toolset_router.py is fully removed.

index.home: the house itself — lights, switches, warmth (climate), and reading what's going on in the rooms
index.media: music and video — play, pause, skip, volume on the speakers and screens
index.house_extras: shouting a message to the speakers, and cancelling timers
index.research: the way I search the web at all now — a real multi-search dig-in in the background, with a write-up and sources when it's done. web_url_read still works for a link you hand me directly.
index.work: proposing a real task for me to hand off — actual file edits, actual commands, running on the host. I can only ever ask; Stephan has to approve it on his phone before anything happens.

_keywords_comment: Used by eva-web/toolset_router.py to pre-attach a group when the user's message matches (word-boundary, case-insensitive). Bias slightly toward matching — a spare tool costs little, a missing one blocks Eva.
